maddeler.e:
اشمئز (form IVq)
# اُشْمُئِزَّ (ušmuʔizza) /uʃ.mu.ʔiz.za/: third-person masculine singular past passive of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# اِشْمَئِزَّ (išmaʔizza) /iʃ.ma.ʔiz.za/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
# اِشْمَئِزِّ (išmaʔizzi) /iʃ.ma.ʔiz.zi/: second-person masculine singular imperative of اِشْمَأَزَّ (išmaʔazza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
